routes.label: Count values in the specified interval

question: Divide 20 data values into 3 categories: no greater than 10, 11 to 20 (including 20), and greater than 20. The data values, in order, are: 8, 12, 25, 10, 17, 21, 5, 14, 30, 19, 11, 9, 22, 16, 13, 28, 7, 18, 24, 15. How many belong to the 11 to 20 category?
solution: The values from 11 to 20 are 12, 17, 14, 19, 11, 16, 13, 18, and 15, a total of 9 values (there are also 5 values no greater than 10 and 6 values greater than 20, giving 20 in total).
